The Quiet Power of Local-First Software

A reflection on software that runs at home.

Local-first applications keep the data under the user's roof. They work without a constant network connection, and they give the user a durable copy of their own work.

But the choice comes with trade-offs. Collaboration is harder, and the on-call burden shifts from the vendor to the operator.

What we lose
Convenience. Auto-scaling. The team that you can page at 3 a.m.

What we gain
Resilience. Predictable cost. A clear audit trail owned by the operator.
